يغتلم (form VIII)
# يَغْتَلِمُ (yaḡtalimu) /jaɣ.ta.li.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)

# يَغْتَلِمْ (yaḡtalim) /jaɣ.ta.lim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
